headlines.title: Verisk Analytics (VRSK) Stock Gets Fair Value Trim As Analysts Debate Growth And AI
headlines.summary: Verisk Analytics has seen its assessed fair value price target adjusted from US$234.76 to US$227.94 as updated assumptions are applied. This change sits within a Street backdrop where some analysts are lifting targets and others are trimming them, as they weigh growth durability, AI execution risk, and valuation. As you read on, you will see how these shifting views fit together and how to track the evolving Verisk Analytics narrative over time.

headlines.title: Verisk Estimates Insured Losses for Hurricane Isaias Could Reach USD 2 Billion
headlines.summary: BOSTON, Oct. 13, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- The Catastrophe and Risk Solutions business at Verisk (Nasdaq: VRSK), a leading strategic data analytics and technology partner to the global insurance industry, estimates insured industry losses to onshore property from Hurricane Isaias will range from USD 1 billion to USD 2 billion. The estimate includes losses from wind and privately insured storm surge resulting from Isaias' landfall in the Florida Panhandle.

headlines.title: 2 Services Stocks to Target This Week and 1 We Avoid
headlines.summary: Business services providers play a critical role for enterprises, assisting them with everything from new hardware integrations to consulting and marketing. Market leaders have certainly capitalized on outsourcing trends and digital transformation initiatives to boost sales, helping fuel a 19.6% gain for the industry over the past six months - 6.1 percentage points higher than the S&P 500.

headlines.title: Verisk Analytics (VRSK): Is Its Insurance-Data Moat Wide Enough to Justify the Price?
headlines.summary: Verisk Analytics, Inc. (NASDAQ:VRSK) is a highly valued data company among the property-and-casualty insurers. The company supplies the rating forms, catastrophe models, and anti-fraud databases that insurers use to price policies and settle claims, tools they cannot easily build themselves.

headlines.title: Is Verisk Analytics (VRSK) Quietly Redefining Its AI Edge With Truepic’s Claims-Verification Tie-Up?
headlines.summary: In September 2026, Truepic announced that its image and video authentication tools are now integrated into Verisk’s ClaimSearch platform, allowing claims professionals to trigger authenticated visual evidence requests directly after a fraud alert and automate parts of the investigation workflow.

description: Verisk Analytics, Inc. engages in the provision of data analytics and technology solutions to the insurance industry in the United States and internationally. The company offers underwriting solutions, including forms, rules, and loss costs services that provides policy language, prospective loss costs, policy writing and rating rules, and underwriting solutions for risk selection and segmentation, pricing, and workflow optimization; underwriting data and analytics solutions, which provides property and auto specific rating, and underwriting information solutions; catastrophe modelling  and risk solutions; life insurance solutions for transforming current workflows in life insurance underwriting, claim insights, policy administration, unclaimed property/equity, compliance and fraud detection, and actuarial and portfolio modelling; specialty business solutions, which provides full end-to-end management of insurance and reinsurance business; and international underwriting solutions. It also provides claims insurance solutions, including property estimating solutions, provide data, analytics, and networking solutions for professionals involved in estimating all phases of building repair and reconstruction; anti-fraud solutions that provide fraud-detection tools for the property and casualty insurance industry; casualty solutions, which focus on compliance, casualty claims decision, and workflow automation; and international claims solutions, which focus on personal injury and motor franchises with complementary offerings to the property claims solutions. The company was founded in 1971 and is headquartered in Jersey City, New Jersey.
